plan.disposition: small iterate; plan applies at medium+

findings.finding: The 'run' key is SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID (the Claude Code session id), not a pipeline run id; a restarted session at the same HEAD writes a fresh baseline and absorbs the earlier session's writes.
findings.suggestion: Key to a restart-stable id, or keep the old baseline when HEAD is unchanged. Disposition: accepted residual, documented in docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md (self-attested trust level).

findings.finding: Removing the boundary exclusion proved nothing: the scratch project was not a git repo, so the gate passed vacuously.
findings.suggestion: git init, leave project-phase output uncommitted, record the baseline. Disposition: FIXED.

findings.finding: On a same-run HEAD move newly dirty paths were added at their current fingerprint, laundering them.
findings.suggestion: Carry old entries forward only. Disposition: FIXED, with a test.

findings.finding: A monorepo subdirectory project root can never pass the boundary gate (fails closed).
findings.suggestion: Use git rev-parse --show-prefix. Disposition: documented; fail-closed is the requested behavior.

findings.finding: write_baseline returns False for both kept and not-at-root; stale docstring.
Capital 'The' after a semicolon; not_written listed twice.

Claim under doubt: Keying to SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID stops a resume from laundering the session's writes — SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID is the per-Claude-session id, so a design phase continued in a new session writes a fresh baseline at the same HEAD. Disposition: accepted residual and documented; the follow-up asked for run keying and no restart-stable run id exists to this phase.

Claim under doubt: Carry-forward keeps pre-commit edits reported — Newly dirty paths were added at their current hash on a HEAD move. Disposition: FIXED (carry old entries only) with a regression test.

Claim under doubt: Same run + moved HEAD means design committed the earlier output — Single-session pipelines re-entering design after build can see a carried-forward entry reported as changed (false red, strict direction). Disposition: accepted; fails closed.

Claim under doubt: A missing SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID is handled — None==None collapses run separation; set/unset mismatch goes strict. Disposition: accepted; both fail closed or equal the previous behavior.
Claim under doubt: at_repo_root misbehaves on Windows paths/symlinks/worktrees — Not broken; a Cygwin-style git path fails closed.
